content.short: From one euro, Bitpanda lets Europeans invest in crypto, stocks, ETFs and precious metals through a single regulated account.
content.description: Bitpanda, based in Vienna, gives European users one account for crypto, fractional stocks and ETFs, indices, commodities and precious metals. Most investments start at one euro, and deposits are free. Crypto can be staked or spent with the Bitpanda Card. Spotlight offers access to early token launches, and the separate Bitpanda DeFi Wallet covers self-custody. More active traders can use Bitpanda Fusion, margin trading on crypto, stocks and ETFs, or API and AI trading through MCP, and its BCI indices track baskets of leading crypto assets.
